Name: Better Quality More Seeds
Author: bmarquismarkail
Description:
This is my mod for Better Quality, More Seeds.

This mod gives the player a seed bonus along with the random ammount if a better quality crop is sent to the Seed Maker.

The bonuses are
Silver = 1 seed
Gold = 2 seeds
Iridium =  3 seeds

To install, Place the Folder into the Mods Folder.
